notes: §1985:XIV.3.1.4 GR2: the CD area "must contain at least the name of the symbolic queue to be tested", and the statement updates the STATUS KEY and MESSAGE COUNT items (Table 1: 00, or 20 "One or more queues or subqueues unknown. No action taken."). MessageControlSession#AcceptMessageCount answers 20 for an unknown or blank queue and 00 with the count otherwise; #Statement writes the status through CommunicationArea#SetStatus (positions 80-81) and keeps the handed image on a refusal. Probes at --std 85: a blank queue gave 20 with count 777777 kept; unknown a and QX gave 20; no mcs.json at all gave 20; a known queue 00 with its count. The witness checks 00 and the count before and after a RECEIVE, and 20 for NOQ.

next.reason: 1985: "Upon execution of the ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT statement, the content of the area specified by a communication description entry"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the Communication module; candidates cover only file I-O status, screen ACCEPT and message tags". No 2023 clause carries ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT or CD STATUS KEY/MESSAGE COUNT. The candidates treat file I-O status and screen ACCEPT, so the communication feature is dropped.
